run_command: python solution/main.py doctor --input input && python solution/main.py run --input input --output output
notes: Source-native adapter for the MLPerf KiTS19 reference 3D U-Net: it loads the frozen TorchScript checkpoint via torch.jit.load and runs 128^3 sliding-window (overlap 0.5) overlap-add inference over each complete preprocessed CT volume on CUDA. main.py --help, doctor and resume work without executing inference; doctor exits 78 listing every missing file/module/CUDA item, and run/resume refuse absent assets with exit 78 (no fake inputs, no CPU fallback). Assets are declared not-ready in the frozen manifest, so doctor/run exit 78 on this host; when the real input tree is mounted, run produces output/masks/*.npy + *.json sidecars, output/volumes.csv (voxels and mL from real spacing), output/manifest.json, output/progress.json (resumable) and output/run.json with config, device, input SHA256s and real timings. Debug (2 cases) is explicitly not claimed as the 42-case reference-large acceptance.
